text: Stepping from a sterile, glass-walled meeting room into the colorful vibrance of a knowledge display about R+D, I feel a certain intellectual thrill. The transition from rigid order to creative chaos excites my curiosity. It feels as though I am moving from the theoretical realm of planning into the practical world of innovation and discovery—a movement both exhilarating and filled with philosophical possibility. Here, I sense the pulse of ideas being born and shared, a dynamic spirit that awakens my mind.
